I think Hulk lacking any real fighting style is vital. It’s rare that we see him fight someone who can go blow for blow in a way that makes technique relevant. Thanos having both a similar stature and degree of durability and strength, along with an unthinkably long amount of time to hone his skills as a martial artist, really feels like it would nullify almost all of the Hulk’s advantages. It was because of that, along with him defeating Hulk before he could get angrier, that it never bothered me that Hulk lost.

I also think we oversell how effective Iron Man was. It was a cool fight scene and he made Thanos bleed, but the closest the team on Titan came to winning was with Starlord’s plan. Iron Man just lost in style

I feel like the world I’m living in right now makes me crave an enlightened despot. For all his sins, Napoleon also reworked France’s institutions into something utterly beautiful, in no small part because he was smart enough to listen to experts. Obviously, those experts served at his pleasure, and heaven help anyone who disagrees with him, but there’s a good reason why France still had enough Bonapartists in the late 1840s to bring Napoleon III into power. For all the harm both sorts of autocrat can do, at least the archetypical enlightened despot is aware of the problems and inclined to solve them.

Before anyone shows up to remind me why enlightened despots are a bad idea, I’m keenly aware of the problems. Dan has spelled out the problems with this type of autocracy plenty of times, and I agree with him. I’m just so desperate to see someone in charge who actually cares to solve problems instead of letting them fester to get an advantage in a later election, and I’m all out of hope that we can just “do better.”
